verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party capability for users to define automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled jobs, workflow triggers, or recurring agent tasks. Webhooks are outbound event notifications. The MCP server lets external AI agents act on request. Transaction monitoring rules and anomaly detection are compliance features, not general user-configured background automations. These are adjacent building blocks or other features, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
